verdict.rationale: Finix documents general dispute monitoring/management via Dashboard or API and evidence upload/response submission (finix-docs-17, finix-docs-18), plus a marketed 'Dispute Management Tools' feature and dispute reporting (finix-docs-22, finix-docs-24), fitting its platform/marketplace seller-onboarding model (finix-docs-4, finix-docs-9). However, none of the evidence explicitly confirms that chargebacks are routed to the correct sub-merchant or that dispute outcomes automatically flow back into seller balances. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-seller/sub-merchant chargeback attribution, and confirmation that dispute resolutions automatically adjust seller balances.
